node.statement: Using (U bold-dot V)^dagger=V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger, two applications of approximate associativity, the exact unit, U^dagger bold-dot U=J, V^dagger bold-dot V=J, and the norm bounds from node 1.2 give ||(U bold-dot V)^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot V)-J||<=20*epsilon+24*epsilon=44*epsilon.
